versions.subject: New rule to detect possible CVE-2020-1048 exploitation
versions.detection:
registryevent:
    EventID: 12 
selection: 
    TargetObject: 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Ports'
    EventType: CreateKey
processevent:
    EventID: 1
selection_2:
    CommandLine|contains: 'Add-PrinterPort -Name'
selection_3:
    CommandLine:
        - '.dll'
        - '.exe'
condition: (selection and registryevent) or (processevent and all of selection_*)
versions.spl: (TargetObject="HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Ports" EventType="CreateKey" EventID=12) OR (EventID=1 CommandLine="*Add-PrinterPort -Name*" CommandLine IN (".dll", ".exe"))

    EventType: CreateKey
    TargetObject|contains:

        - 'C:'

selection2:

        - '.exe'
